basic.name: System Warning
basic.description: At Lv. 6, deals Quantum DMG equal to 100% of Silver Wolf's ATK to one enemy.

skill.name: Allow Changes?
skill.description: At Lv. 10, has a 120% base chance to implant a Weakness matching an ally for 3 turns and reduce that Weakness Type's RES by 20%. It also has a 100% base chance to reduce All-Type RES by 13% for 2 turns and deals Quantum DMG equal to 196% of ATK.

ultimate.name: User Banned
ultimate.description: At Lv. 10, has a 120% base chance to reduce all enemies' DEF by 45% for 3 turns, then deals Quantum DMG equal to 380% of Silver Wolf's ATK to all enemies.

talent.name: Awaiting System Response...
talent.description: Silver Wolf can apply Bugs that reduce ATK by 10%, DEF by 12%, or SPD by 6%. After each attack, she has a 100% base chance to implant one random Bug for 3 turns. Her implanted Weakness can transfer to another surviving enemy when its target is defeated.

technique.name: Force Quit Program
technique.description: Attacks enemies upon entering battle, reduces Toughness regardless of Weakness Type, and triggers the Quantum Weakness Break effect when this attack breaks an enemy.

2.name: Generate
2.description: Extends Bug duration by 1 turn. Whenever an enemy is Weakness Broken, Silver Wolf has a 100% base chance to implant a random Bug.

4.name: Inject
4.description: Immediately regenerates 20 Energy at the start of battle and regenerates 5 Energy at the start of each Silver Wolf turn.

6.name: Side Note
6.description: For every 10% Effect Hit Rate Silver Wolf has, increases her ATK by 10%, up to a maximum increase of 50%.

eidolons.name: Social Engineering
eidolons.description: After using her Ultimate, Silver Wolf regenerates 7 Energy for every debuff on the target, up to 5 times per Ultimate.

eidolons.name: Zombie Network
eidolons.description: When an enemy enters battle, its DMG received increases by 20%. When an ally attacks that enemy, Silver Wolf has a 100% base chance to implant one random Bug.

eidolons.name: Payload
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2 and Talent Lv. +2, up to their respective maximum levels.

eidolons.name: Bounce Attack
eidolons.description: After Silver Wolf uses her Ultimate, deals additional Quantum DMG equal to 20% of her ATK for every debuff on the target, up to 5 times per target.

eidolons.name: Brute Force Attack
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2 and Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to their respective maximum levels.

eidolons.name: Overlay Network
eidolons.description: Silver Wolf deals 20% more DMG for every debuff on the target, up to a maximum increase of 100%.
